newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa due barely changed, lacks direction.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa due barely changed, lacks direction.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa is due to open little changed, with technical analysts seeing a move either way as possible on Thursday.
Traders called benchmark Sept to open unchanged or one stg higher.
On a technical basis, a feature of the market was the flag formation formed roughly between 1,100 and 1,140 stg a tonne, Adrian Haylor, analyst at Sucden, said.
It had moved up out of the flag range on Tuesday, but come back, closing the gap created on Wednesday.
Noting that the RSI looked overbought, Haylor said there was scope for a correction.
The bullish outlook would be reversed only if the market were to move back below 1,100.
But while the 1,100 level remained intact, there was also scope for the market to blip higher to 1,172, Haylor said.
New York cocoa futures ended broadly lower on Wednesday in a relatively modest setback following Tuesday's rally to nine-year highs, traders said.
However, the market stalled in the afternoon and lacked the follow-through selling needed to make a convincing correction.
LIFFE cocoa futures stayed lower by the close on Wednesday on trade profit-taking, stalling a rally that lifted the market to a 12-month high earlier this week.
